verdict.rationale: Xero's marketing says it generates consolidated financial statements in multiple currencies with accurate financial reporting, and gives instant answers on cash flow and profit trends. That implies statement reporting, but the evidence never names a P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement, and never shows custom-period generation. Missing for 10: explicit P&L/balance sheet/cash-flow statement documentation, arbitrary or any-period on-demand reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.
